purpose: Trigger-boundary regression set for ugt-nextjs-auth-setup. S* queries must route here (login methods, RBAC/permissions, documented auth symptoms); N* must NOT (DB plumbing → database-setup, page theming → design-setup, CI → cicd-setup).
method: 3 independent judges, randomized order, full skill listing incl. superpowers distractors

baseline_result.method_note: Judges ran as subagents given the skill listing as TEXT (generated from the repo SKILL.md frontmatter) and instructed to answer only from it — the 2026-08-03 contamination, where judges named their own environment skills, did not recur: every answer came from the supplied listing.
baseline_result.note: S-side 27/27, including all six production-symptom queries (redirect loop, cookie not clearing on https, `Unexpected token '<'`, invalid redirect_uri) — the documented-symptom sentences in the description are doing real routing work. N-side 15/15; one secondary variance where 'เขียน test ให้ flow login' was read as no-skill rather than TDD, which does not affect this skill's boundary.

revalidation_2026-08-25.reason: SKILL.md §7 restructured (backlog §10) — 39-row DO/DON'T table cut to 5 rows, the other 34 were near-verbatim duplicates of §2/auth-flows.md/rbac.md/data-scope.md/directory-enrichment.md. Frontmatter description was NOT touched by that edit. Re-ran the trigger check to confirm the boundary held.
revalidation_2026-08-25.secondary_accuracy: 13/15 — N1/N3/N4/N5 all correct across all 3 judges; N2 (theme/color query) split 1/3 design-setup vs 2/3 no-skill
revalidation_2026-08-25.note: N2's wobble is between design-setup and no-skill, not auth-setup — it does not touch this skill's boundary and is not caused by this edit (neither auth-setup's frontmatter nor design-setup's listing entry changed). Confirms the §7 cut is trigger-neutral, as expected since judges are given only the frontmatter description, never the SKILL.md body.
